message:
When running `brew bundle dump --global` for the first time, Homebrew was ignoring `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and falling back to `~/.Brewfile` instead of creating the Brewfile in the XDG-compliant location `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}/homebrew/Brewfile`.

The issue was in the path resolution logic in `Library/Homebrew/bundle/brewfile.rb` which checked for the existence of the Brewfile before deciding to use the XDG path:

```ruby
if user_config_home && File.exist?("#{user_config_home}/Brewfile")
```

This meant that for initial dumps where no Brewfile existed yet, it would fall back to the legacy path even when `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` was properly set.

## Changes Made

1. **Enhanced path resolution logic** in `brewfile.rb` to intelligently choose between XDG and legacy paths while maintaining full backwards compatibility:
   - When XDG is not set: uses legacy path (unchanged behavior)
   - When XDG file exists: uses XDG path (unchanged)  
   - When legacy file exists but XDG doesn't: uses legacy path (maintains backwards compatibility)
   - When neither exists: uses XDG path (fixes the initial creation issue)

2. **Added directory creation** in `dumper.rb` using `Pathname#mkpath` to ensure the XDG directory structure is created automatically when needed

3. **Added comprehensive test coverage** for all backwards compatibility scenarios including when `HOMEBREW_USER_CONFIG_HOME` is set but neither file exists yet

4. **Refined XDG detection logic** based on reviewer feedback to properly distinguish between XDG paths (`${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}/homebrew`) and legacy paths (`${HOME}/.homebrew`) by checking if `HOMEBREW_USER_CONFIG_HOME` ends with `/homebrew`

5. **Implemented lazy evaluation** to avoid expensive operations unless necessary and restructured conditional logic to reduce duplication

## Behavior After Fix

- `XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/custom/path brew bundle dump --global` → creates `/custom/path/homebrew/Brewfile` (only when no existing files)
- Default behavior (no `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`) → still creates `~/.Brewfile` as expected (unchanged)
- Existing legacy `~/.Brewfile` files are preserved and used even when XDG is configured (backwards compatible)
- Existing Brewfiles in XDG locations continue to work unchanged
- `HOMEBREW_BUNDLE_FILE_GLOBAL` override continues to take precedence

## Backwards Compatibility

This implementation ensures that no existing workflows are disrupted. Users with existing `~/.Brewfile` files will continue to use them even after setting `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, maintaining full backwards compatibility while still enabling XDG compliance for new installations.

Fixes #20628.
